sensitiveHandoff: This is something that really deserves a person alongside you — not just an app. I don’t want to shape a plan here that a good professional should walk with you on. If it helps, you can still set up a Journey yourself, and I’ll be here to support you as you go.
retry: I didn’t quite catch that — my connection may have hiccuped. Mind telling me once more?

journeyCard.defaultDescription: A plan paced for your real week, built around what you just told me.

edit.greeting: Let's tune "{{title}}". Tell me what you'd like to change, and I'll show you the exact update before anything happens.
edit.placeholder: What would you like to change?
edit.noChange: I didn't catch a change there. Tell me what you'd like to adjust and I'll show you the update.
edit.error: Something hiccuped on my end. Mind telling me once more?

opening.intro: Hey, good to have you here. Tell me what's on your mind and we'll figure it out together. Nothing is too small to bring up.
opening.question: So, what do you want to work on?

reflect.userEcho: I want to start drinking more protein every day, and I keep meaning to build up my push-ups but never actually start.
reflect.coach: Okay, I hear two things. One is a daily habit, drinking more protein. The other is a real plan, building up your push-ups. Let's start with one, and I'll keep the other safe for later.

focus.insight: Going from zero to a strong set in three weeks is a big ask. Give it six to eight weeks and you get a real change, not just a number.
focus.journeyDescription: A steady build over six to eight weeks, from your first knee push-up to a confident set of 15. It's paced for a busy week, not a sprint.
